Title: Public Preview: NFS Azure Files volume mount support in Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps now supports mounting Network File System (NFS) Azure Files volumes to your containerized applications. This feature is in public preview. NFS Azure Files volumes provide a scalable and high-performance file system for your apps and jobs. You can use NFS Azure Files volumes to share data between multiple containers in your application, or to persist data across container restarts.

Learn more
